description: Send Binance-Peg USDC from BNB Chain and receive Tether USDT on Ethereum. The peg uses 18 decimals. Match both contracts on BscScan and Etherscan. Keep ETH.
intro:
Swap USDC from BNB Chain to USDT on Ethereum. You send Binance-Peg USDC on BNB Chain and you receive Tether USDT on Ethereum.

The token you approve is 0x8AC76a51cc950d9822D68b83fE1Ad97B32Cd580d. BscScan lists it on chain id 56. Gas is BNB, and blocks are about 3 seconds. That peg uses 18 decimals, not the 6 decimals of Circle USDC on Ethereum. Tether on Ethereum is 0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7, which you match on Etherscan. Chain id 1 charges gas in ETH. The USDT you receive will not pay that fee.

sections.heading: Peg USDC is not Ethereum USDC
sections.body: 0x8AC76a51cc950d9822D68b83fE1Ad97B32Cd580d is the Binance-Peg token on BNB Chain. Approving Ethereum's Circle contract does nothing here, because that contract is on another chain. You need BNB for gas beside the peg. A swap from this peg into USDT on BNB Chain never creates an Ethereum balance. Native BNB is not the input on this page.

sections.heading: Tether on Ethereum uses six decimals
sections.body: The payout contract is 0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7. It is Tether, not Maker DAI, and not Circle USDC. Etherscan is the explorer for that result. A raw integer copied from BscScan will look enormous next to Ethereum USDT because 18 decimals became 6. Read the quote in whole tokens. Then keep ETH on Ethereum or the new USDT cannot move.

sections.heading: Wrong tool if you wanted DAI, ETH, or a local swap
sections.body: DAI, native ETH, and WETH are different pages. If both tokens you care about already trade on BNB Chain, bridging is the wrong tool. The issuer also changes, from the peg you hold to Tether on Ethereum. [BNB Chain](/chains/bsc) is only the source. The quote does not lock a USDT amount, and a 3 second block is not a delivery promise.

sections.heading: BNB pays the send, ETH pays the next move
sections.body: Budget BNB for the approval and the swap on chain id 56. Budget ETH on chain id 1 before you try to use the USDT. Those coins are not substitutes. The minimum USDT on the quote is the floor if the price moves while the route is open. If that floor is short, do not sign. Do not paste an address from a message into the destination.

faqs.question: Why does my BNB Chain USDC show more zeros than Ethereum USDT?
faqs.answer: The Binance-Peg token at 0x8AC76a51cc950d9822D68b83fE1Ad97B32Cd580d uses 18 decimals. Tether on Ethereum, 0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7, uses 6. BscScan and Etherscan are showing different scales. Use the quote's whole-token amounts. You still need BNB for gas on the way out and ETH on Ethereum after the USDT arrives.

faqs.question: Is this the same USDC I would swap on Ethereum?
faqs.answer: No. Ethereum USDC is Circle's contract on chain id 1. This page spends the BNB Chain peg and pays Tether, not Circle. Etherscan should show 0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7 when the route finishes. If you only needed USDT next to your BNB, stay on BNB Chain. This hop is the wrong tool for that.

faqs.question: Will the USDT be spendable the moment BscScan shows the send?
faqs.answer: No. BNB Chain blocks are about 3 seconds, and that only covers the source chain. The bridge wait is separate, and this page does not promise a clock or a price. When Etherscan shows the USDT, you still need ETH in that wallet. Tether does not pay Ethereum gas.

description: Send Binance-Peg USDC from BNB Chain and receive Maker DAI on Ethereum. You change issuer. Match both contracts on BscScan and Etherscan before you sign.
intro:
Swap USDC from BNB Chain to DAI on Ethereum. You send Binance-Peg USDC on BNB Chain and you receive Maker DAI on Ethereum.

Approve 0x8AC76a51cc950d9822D68b83fE1Ad97B32Cd580d on BNB Chain. BscScan is the explorer, chain id 56, gas in BNB, blocks about 3 seconds. The peg is an 18-decimal token. Maker DAI on Ethereum is 0x6B175474E89094C44Da98b954EedeAC495271d0F, also 18 decimals, which you match on Etherscan. Chain id 1. Gas there is ETH. DAI will not pay it. Circle and Maker are different issuers even when both amounts look like dollars.

sections.heading: Circle's peg against Maker's DAI
sections.body: The source is the Binance-Peg USDC contract, not Tether and not BNB. You approve 0x8AC76a51cc950d9822D68b83fE1Ad97B32Cd580d and you keep BNB for the fee. The destination is Maker's token, not a USDC balance that followed you. If a venue on Ethereum only accepts Circle USDC, this page is the wrong tool before you even look at the quote.

sections.heading: Same decimal count, different chains
sections.body: Both contracts use 18 decimals, so the integer scale is less confusing than a hop into 6-decimal USDT. They are still different tokens on different explorers. BscScan proves the peg left. Etherscan should show 0x6B175474E89094C44Da98b954EedeAC495271d0F arriving. DAI cannot pay gas on chain id 1. Hold ETH in the receiving wallet.

sections.heading: Skip this if the desk asked for Tether
sections.body: USDT on Ethereum is another contract and another page. Native ETH and WETH are other pages too. A USDC to DAI trade that never leaves BNB Chain is smaller if you did not need Ethereum. [Ethereum](/chains/ethereum) is the network that will custody the DAI. Nothing on the quote freezes the DAI amount or names a finish time.

sections.heading: Arrive with DAI and still need ETH
sections.body: People see a dollar token arrive and assume they can move it. On Ethereum the fee coin is ETH, chain id 1, and blocks there are about 12 seconds, which is slower than BNB Chain and unrelated to the bridge wait. Read the minimum DAI before you sign. If it is below what you will accept, leave the quote unsigned.

faqs.question: Is DAI on this route the same issuer as the USDC I am sending?
faqs.answer: No. You send the Binance-Peg USDC at 0x8AC76a51cc950d9822D68b83fE1Ad97B32Cd580d, and you receive Maker DAI at 0x6B175474E89094C44Da98b954EedeAC495271d0F. BscScan and Etherscan list those contracts on different chains. Gas out is BNB. Gas after arrival is ETH. DAI itself does not pay Ethereum fees.

faqs.question: Do the matching 18-decimal scales mean the amounts are one for one?
faqs.answer: No. Shared decimals only mean you should not panic at the raw integers. The quote can still move, and this page does not promise a price. Use the minimum DAI. BNB Chain blocks near 3 seconds do not lock that minimum. If you needed Tether instead of Maker, switch pages before you sign.

faqs.question: Can I pay the Ethereum fee with the DAI when it lands?
faqs.answer: No. Ethereum gas is ETH on chain id 1. Etherscan will show the DAI token at 0x6B175474E89094C44Da98b954EedeAC495271d0F, and that token cannot buy gas by itself. If the receiving wallet has no ETH, the DAI sits still. Bring ETH before you need to transfer it.

description: Send Binance-Peg USDC from BNB Chain and receive native ETH on Ethereum. The payout is the gas coin, not WETH. Check BscScan and Etherscan before you sign.
intro:
Swap USDC from BNB Chain to ETH on Ethereum. You send Binance-Peg USDC on BNB Chain and you receive native ETH on Ethereum, the coin that pays gas there.

Approve 0x8AC76a51cc950d9822D68b83fE1Ad97B32Cd580d. BscScan shows that 18-decimal peg on chain id 56. Gas for the approval is BNB, and blocks are about 3 seconds. The Ethereum side uses 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE, the marker for the gas coin. On Ethereum that coin is ETH, not BNB and not WETH. Etherscan shows the native balance. Chain id 1. Blocks there are about 12 seconds.

sections.heading: Dollars in, Ethereum's gas coin out
sections.body: You are selling the Binance-Peg USDC and taking ETH price exposure. The input contract is only 0x8AC76a51cc950d9822D68b83fE1Ad97B32Cd580d. Tether and DAI on BNB Chain will not be pulled. Keep BNB for gas. If your goal was a dollar token on Ethereum, this page is the wrong tool, because the payout is not USDT, USDC, or DAI.

sections.heading: The marker on the way out means ETH
sections.body: 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE is not an ERC-20 you open on Etherscan. On this destination it means native ETH. The same string on BNB Chain would mean BNB, but that is not the input here. The ETH you receive can pay later Ethereum fees. It is still not WETH, and unwrapping is not what this route does.

sections.heading: Not the page for WETH or for BNB
sections.body: If you need the WETH contract, use the WETH page. If you meant to spend native BNB, use the BNB page. This one spends the peg USDC only. Staying on BNB Chain is better when you did not need Ethereum ETH at all. [How bridges work](/learn/how-do-cross-chain-bridges-work) explains the wait in general. No ETH price is locked.

sections.heading: The ETH you receive can pay later fees
sections.body: Unlike a USDT or DAI landing, this payout is the fee coin, so you do not need a prior ETH balance for the credit to be usable. You do need BNB on the source. Read the minimum ETH, not only the estimate. A 3 second BNB Chain block and a 12 second Ethereum block do not add up to a promised finish. Sign on chain id 56.

faqs.question: Does the long 0xEeee address mean I am sending BNB?
faqs.answer: On this page, no. The marker 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE is the destination, and on Ethereum it means native ETH. The token you send is Binance-Peg USDC, 0x8AC76a51cc950d9822D68b83fE1Ad97B32Cd580d, which you approve on BscScan. Gas for that approval is BNB. Etherscan should later show ETH, not a token contract.

faqs.question: Will I get WETH that I still have to unwrap?
faqs.answer: No. This route pays native ETH, the gas coin on chain id 1. WETH is a different contract and a different page. You will not sign an unwrap after arrival. You still pay BNB on the way out. If you specifically need the WETH contract in a pool, leave this quote and open the WETH route.

faqs.question: Is the amount of ETH fixed when BNB Chain confirms quickly?
faqs.answer: No. Blocks near 3 seconds are only the source chain. ETH can move while the bridge is open, and this page does not promise a price or a completion time. Judge the minimum ETH on the quote. If it is too small for the USDC you are selling, do not sign.

description: Send Binance-Peg USDC from BNB Chain and receive WETH on Ethereum. WETH is not the gas coin. Match both contracts on BscScan and Etherscan before you sign.
intro:
Swap USDC from BNB Chain to WETH on Ethereum. You send Binance-Peg USDC on BNB Chain and you receive WETH on Ethereum, not native ETH.

The peg you approve is 0x8AC76a51cc950d9822D68b83fE1Ad97B32Cd580d. BscScan lists it on chain id 56, gas in BNB, blocks about 3 seconds, 18 decimals. WETH on Ethereum is 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2. Match that contract on Etherscan. Chain id 1. Gas there is native ETH, and WETH cannot pay it. Blocks on Ethereum are about 12 seconds. The wrapper and the gas coin are different balances.

sections.heading: A peg dollar buys the wrapper, not gas
sections.body: This page takes 0x8AC76a51cc950d9822D68b83fE1Ad97B32Cd580d and pays the WETH contract. It does not pay native ETH. If you wanted ETH you can spend on fees, you are on the wrong tool. Keep BNB on BNB Chain for the approval. The peg's 18 decimals should be read from the quote, not from a raw BscScan integer compared with WETH.

sections.heading: WETH's contract on Etherscan
sections.body: 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2 is canonical WETH on Ethereum. It is not Binance-Peg ETH, and it is not the 0xEeee marker. Etherscan should show that exact contract. You will need native ETH already in the receiving wallet before you can approve or move the WETH. Arriving WETH does not include that gas.

sections.heading: Native ETH is the page you wanted if you need fees
sections.body: Open the ETH payout if the point was a spendable gas balance. Open USDT or DAI if you wanted dollars on Ethereum. A same-chain swap on BNB Chain is enough when WETH on Ethereum was never the goal. The [bridge guide](/learn/guides/how-to-bridge-assets-between-chains) is the hop, not a fee estimate. No WETH amount is promised.

sections.heading: Dry Ethereum wallet, immovable wrapper
sections.body: The failure mode is a successful-looking route into a wallet with zero ETH. WETH sits at 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2 and cannot pay for its own transfer. Read the minimum WETH before you sign on chain id 56. BNB Chain's faster blocks do not shrink the later Ethereum fee. If the minimum is poor, do not sign.

faqs.question: Can I unwrap this payout into ETH without extra gas?
faqs.answer: Unwrapping WETH at 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2 stays on Ethereum and still costs native ETH. This route does not do that unwrap for you. Etherscan will show the wrapper, not a native credit. If you needed the gas coin itself, use the native ETH page. Gas on the send remains BNB, checked on BscScan.

faqs.question: Is Binance-Peg ETH the same token I will receive?
faqs.answer: No. The input is Binance-Peg USDC, 0x8AC76a51cc950d9822D68b83fE1Ad97B32Cd580d. The output is Ethereum WETH, 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2. Binance-Peg ETH is a different contract on BNB Chain. BscScan and Etherscan will not show one balance. You need BNB to send and ETH already waiting to move the WETH.

faqs.question: Does a 3 second block mean the WETH is already on Ethereum?
faqs.answer: No. That pace is BNB Chain only. Ethereum blocks are about 12 seconds, and the bridge adds its own wait, which this page does not clock. The quote is an estimate. Accept or reject the minimum WETH. WETH cannot pay the Ethereum fee when it arrives.

description: Send Binance-Peg USDT from BNB Chain and receive Circle USDC on Ethereum. Decimals change from 18 to 6. Match both contracts on BscScan and Etherscan.
intro:
Swap USDT from BNB Chain to USDC on Ethereum. You send Binance-Peg USDT on BNB Chain and you receive Circle USDC on Ethereum.

Tether's peg on BNB Chain is 0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955, 18 decimals. You approve it. BscScan shows the contract on chain id 56. Gas is BNB and blocks are about 3 seconds. Circle USDC on Ethereum is 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48, 6 decimals. Match it on Etherscan. Chain id 1. Gas there is ETH. You changed issuer, from Tether to Circle, and you changed chain.

sections.heading: Tether's 18-decimal peg on BscScan
sections.body: Only 0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955 is the input. The Binance-Peg USDC contract will not satisfy this page, and native BNB will not either. Keep BNB for the approval. Do not compare the raw peg integer with Ethereum USDC and call the gap a fee. The quote already speaks in whole tokens.

sections.heading: Circle's six-decimal contract on Etherscan
sections.body: The payout is 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48. It is Circle, not Tether, and not Maker DAI. Etherscan is the check. USDC cannot pay Ethereum gas. A wallet with USDC and no ETH cannot make the next transfer. The 6-decimal scale will make the raw amount look small next to the 18-decimal peg you sent.

sections.heading: Stay on BNB Chain if the issuer change was an accident
sections.body: If you needed Tether on Ethereum, this page is the wrong tool. If you needed USDC on BNB Chain, swap there. Native ETH and WETH are different endings again. [BNB Chain](/chains/bsc) is the network you are leaving. The quote does not promise how many Circle dollars survive the hop, and it does not promise when Etherscan will show them.

sections.heading: Two explorers and a second gas coin
sections.body: BscScan confirms the peg left chain id 56. Etherscan confirms Circle USDC on chain id 1. BNB pays the first side. ETH pays the second. Read the minimum USDC before you sign. A block about every 3 seconds on BNB Chain does not cap the Ethereum fee and does not end the bridge wait. If the floor is low, do not sign.

faqs.question: Is BNB Chain USDT the same contract as Ethereum USDT?
faqs.answer: No. You send 0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955, the 18-decimal peg on BscScan. You do not receive Ethereum USDT. You receive Circle USDC at 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48 on Etherscan. Gas out is BNB on chain id 56. Gas after arrival is ETH. USDC will not pay that ETH fee.

faqs.question: Why is the raw USDC number so much smaller?
faqs.answer: Circle USDC on Ethereum uses 6 decimals. The peg you sent uses 18. The quote's human amount is the one to read, then the minimum under it. Do not treat the integer gap as money lost. If that minimum is still worse than you accept, refresh the quote. This page does not lock a price.

faqs.question: What if the venue I am paying only takes Tether?
faqs.answer: Then this route is the wrong tool. It pays Circle, contract 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48. Tether on Ethereum is a different page. Signing here because both are called dollars still leaves you holding USDC. Check the payout on Etherscan before you send it onward, and keep ETH for gas.

description: Send Binance-Peg USDT from BNB Chain and receive Maker DAI on Ethereum. Tether becomes Maker. Match both contracts on BscScan and Etherscan before you sign.
intro:
Swap USDT from BNB Chain to DAI on Ethereum. You send Binance-Peg USDT on BNB Chain and you receive Maker DAI on Ethereum.

Approve 0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955. BscScan lists that 18-decimal Tether peg on chain id 56. Gas is BNB. Blocks are about 3 seconds. Maker DAI is 0x6B175474E89094C44Da98b954EedeAC495271d0F on Ethereum, also 18 decimals. Match it on Etherscan. Chain id 1. You need ETH in the receiving wallet because DAI cannot pay gas. Tether and Maker are not the same issuer.

sections.heading: Tether in, Maker out
sections.body: The input contract is only 0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955. Binance-Peg USDC is a different approval. Native BNB is a different page. You are leaving Tether and arriving in Maker's token. If your counterparty asked for USDC or for Ethereum USDT, stop. This quote will not switch the payout to match a ticker you prefer.

sections.heading: DAI does not pay Ethereum gas
sections.body: Etherscan should show 0x6B175474E89094C44Da98b954EedeAC495271d0F. That balance is useless for fees. ETH on chain id 1 is the fee coin, and Ethereum blocks are about 12 seconds once you are moving the DAI. BNB you still hold on BNB Chain cannot pay that fee. Bring ETH before you need to forward the DAI.

sections.heading: USDC and native ETH are different endings
sections.body: Circle USDC, native ETH, and WETH each have a route from this same peg. This page is the wrong tool for all three. It is also the wrong tool if you only wanted DAI on BNB Chain, because you never needed Ethereum. [Ethereum](/chains/ethereum) is the destination network. The minimum DAI is not a locked price.

sections.heading: Read the minimum, ignore the raw integers
sections.body: Both tokens use 18 decimals, which removes one source of confusion and leaves the real one: price and fees. Read the DAI minimum on the quote. BNB gas on chain id 56 is separate. A 3 second block is the source pace only. If the floor is thinner than the Tether you are spending, do not sign, and do not trust a destination pasted from chat.

faqs.question: Does this deliver Ethereum USDT because I started with USDT?
faqs.answer: No. The ticker changes. You send the BNB Chain peg 0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955 and you receive Maker DAI at 0x6B175474E89094C44Da98b954EedeAC495271d0F. BscScan and Etherscan are the two checks. If you needed Tether to stay Tether, this is the wrong tool. You also need ETH after arrival, because DAI cannot pay gas.

faqs.question: Are the amounts equal because both tokens use 18 decimals?
faqs.answer: No. Matching decimals only makes the raw integers easier to misread as a price. The quote can move while BNB Chain confirms and while the bridge is open. Use the minimum DAI. This page does not promise a fill. Gas on the send is BNB, on chain id 56, about a 3 second block.

faqs.question: What do I need in the Ethereum wallet besides the DAI?
faqs.answer: ETH. Maker DAI at 0x6B175474E89094C44Da98b954EedeAC495271d0F cannot pay fees on chain id 1. Etherscan can show a healthy DAI balance in a wallet that still cannot move it. BNB left on BNB Chain does not help. Add ETH before you try to send the DAI onward.

description: Send Binance-Peg USDT from BNB Chain and receive native ETH on Ethereum. You leave Tether for the gas coin. Check BscScan and Etherscan before you sign.
intro:
Swap USDT from BNB Chain to ETH on Ethereum. You send Binance-Peg USDT on BNB Chain and you receive native ETH on Ethereum.

The peg is 0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955, 18 decimals, approved on BNB Chain. BscScan shows it. Chain id 56, gas in BNB, blocks about 3 seconds. The payout marker is 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE, which on Ethereum means native ETH, the gas coin. Etherscan shows that balance, not a token page. Chain id 1. This is not WETH and not a dollar token.

sections.heading: Selling Tether for spendable ether
sections.body: You leave a peg that tracks a dollar and you take ETH exposure. The only input is 0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955. USDC and DAI pegs on BNB Chain are different contracts. Keep BNB so the approval can be mined. If you wanted USDC or DAI on Ethereum, this payout is the wrong tool.

sections.heading: Native ETH uses the placeholder
sections.body: 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE is not WETH and not a contract with holders on Etherscan. On this destination it means ETH. That ETH can pay later fees on chain id 1. Do not search the placeholder as if it were an ERC-20. Do not confuse it with BNB just because BNB Chain uses the same marker for its own gas coin.

sections.heading: WETH and USDC would be the wrong result
sections.body: Pools that want the WETH contract need the other page. Desks that want Circle USDC need the other page. Staying on BNB Chain is right when you only needed to exit USDT into BNB. The [bridge guide](/learn/guides/how-to-bridge-assets-between-chains) is worth reading if this is your first hop onto Ethereum. No ETH price is guaranteed.

sections.heading: Leave BNB on the source wallet
sections.body: Spending every BNB and leaving only the USDT peg will stall the approval. The ETH you receive does not refund that BNB. Read the minimum ETH against the Tether you give up. Both the 3 second BNB Chain block and the 12 second Ethereum block are chain facts, not a promise that the swap is finished. Sign on chain id 56 only.

faqs.question: Does receiving ETH mean I can skip holding ETH first?
faqs.answer: Yes for the destination. Native ETH from this route can pay Ethereum gas after it arrives. You do not need a prior ETH balance for that credit to be usable. You do need BNB on chain id 56 to approve 0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955. Etherscan shows the ETH. The marker is 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE.

faqs.question: Is this the same as receiving WETH?
faqs.answer: No. WETH is 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2 and cannot pay gas until you unwrap it, which costs ETH you would already need. This page pays the gas coin itself. If a contract on Ethereum demands the WETH token, you are on the wrong route. BscScan is only the source side.

faqs.question: Can the ETH amount change after BNB Chain looks finished?
faqs.answer: The source block is about 3 seconds. That is not the whole route, and ETH can move while the bridge is open. This page does not promise a price or a completion time. The minimum ETH on the quote is the number to accept or reject. If you have not signed, refresh when the quote expires.

description: Send Binance-Peg USDT from BNB Chain and receive WETH on Ethereum. WETH cannot pay gas. Match the peg on BscScan and the WETH contract on Etherscan first.
intro:
Swap USDT from BNB Chain to WETH on Ethereum. You send Binance-Peg USDT on BNB Chain and you receive WETH on Ethereum.

Approve 0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955 on BNB Chain. BscScan is the explorer for that 18-decimal peg. Chain id 56, gas in BNB, blocks about 3 seconds. WETH is 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2 on Ethereum. Match it on Etherscan. It is not native ETH. Chain id 1 still charges gas in ETH, with blocks about 12 seconds. The wrapper you receive cannot pay that charge.

sections.heading: The payout cannot pay the fee
sections.body: WETH at 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2 is an ERC-20. Ethereum gas is a separate native balance. If the receiving wallet has no ETH, the WETH arrives and then sits. This is the central way to misuse the page. The source side is simpler: BNB pays the approval of the Tether peg, and the peg itself is not BNB.

sections.heading: Wrapper contract versus the peg you sent
sections.body: The input 0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955 is Tether's peg, not Binance-Peg ETH and not USDC. The output is canonical WETH, not the 0xEeee marker. Etherscan and BscScan will never show a single combined balance. Read whole tokens on the quote so the 18-decimal peg does not get compared raw with WETH.

sections.heading: Open the native ETH page if you need gas
sections.body: If the reason for the hop was fee money on Ethereum, native ETH is the right payout and this page is the wrong tool. USDC and DAI pages are the right tool when you wanted a dollar token. [How cross-chain bridges work](/learn/how-do-cross-chain-bridges-work) is background for the wait. It is not a locked WETH price.

sections.heading: Two networks, one floor
sections.body: Sign the approval on chain id 56 only after you accept the minimum WETH. BNB Chain can include the transaction in about 3 seconds and the route can still be unfinished. Ethereum's 12 second blocks are another fact, not a timer for the bridge. Keep ETH waiting on the destination. Do not spend your last BNB on a larger peg balance.

faqs.question: Will this WETH show up as spendable ETH in my wallet?
faqs.answer: No. Wallets list WETH at 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2 apart from the native ETH balance. Etherscan does the same. The native coin pays gas. The token you sent was 0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955 on BscScan. If you needed fee ETH, use the native ETH route instead of this one.

faqs.question: Do I approve WETH on Ethereum before it arrives?
faqs.answer: No. The approval you need first is for the BNB Chain peg, and it spends BNB. WETH may need its own approval later, when you want to use it in a pool, and that later approval spends ETH you must already hold. This page does not pre-approve anything on Ethereum. Chain id on the destination is 1.

faqs.question: What if I hold USDC on BNB Chain and not this USDT peg?
faqs.answer: This page will not take it. USDC is 0x8AC76a51cc950d9822D68b83fE1Ad97B32Cd580d and has its own route to WETH. Approving the wrong peg does not start the swap. Check 0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955 on BscScan before you sign. The payout contract does not change to match whatever stablecoin you happen to hold.

description: Send Binance-Peg ETH from BNB Chain and receive Circle USDC on Ethereum. This peg is not BNB and not native ETH. Match both contracts before you sign.
intro:
Swap ETH from BNB Chain to USDC on Ethereum. You send Binance-Peg ETH, a token on BNB Chain, and you receive Circle USDC on Ethereum.

The token is 0x2170Ed0880ac9A755fd29B2688956BD959F933F8. You approve it. BscScan lists that contract on chain id 56. It is not native ETH, and it is not BNB. Gas is BNB, with blocks about 3 seconds. Circle USDC on Ethereum is 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48, six decimals, which you match on Etherscan. Chain id 1. USDC cannot pay ETH gas.

sections.heading: The ticker says ETH, the contract is a peg
sections.body: Wallets label 0x2170Ed0880ac9A755fd29B2688956BD959F933F8 as ETH. The gas coin in that same wallet is BNB. This page spends the peg, not the gas coin. If you only hold BNB, the approval will not find a balance. If you hold native ETH on Ethereum already, this route does not move that balance either. It starts on BNB Chain.

sections.heading: Circle USDC still needs real ETH later
sections.body: The payout is 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48 on Etherscan. It is Circle, not Tether and not DAI. Six decimals will make the raw amount look smaller than the 18-decimal peg you approved. Read the quote. Then put ETH on Ethereum, because the USDC cannot pay chain id 1 fees. BNB left behind cannot pay them either.

sections.heading: BNB and native ether are other routes
sections.body: Spending BNB is a different page. Receiving native ETH, WETH, or Tether is a different page. This one is only peg ETH in, Circle USDC out. A local swap on BNB Chain is the wrong tool to skip only if you truly need Ethereum USDC. Otherwise it is the smaller trade. See [BNB Chain](/chains/bsc) for the source network. No USDC total is locked.

sections.heading: Eighteen decimals against six
sections.body: Do not subtract the raw peg integer from the raw USDC integer. The quote's minimum is the floor. BNB gas is extra on the way out. A block near 3 seconds on chain id 56 is not a promise that Etherscan already shows the USDC. Sign from the wallet that holds this exact peg contract. Ignore destinations that arrive in a message.

faqs.question: Is the ETH on BNB Chain the same coin that pays Ethereum gas?
faqs.answer: No. The BNB Chain token is 0x2170Ed0880ac9A755fd29B2688956BD959F933F8, a peg you approve on BscScan. Gas on BNB Chain is BNB. Gas on Ethereum is native ETH, a different coin on chain id 1. This page pays Circle USDC, 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48, which also cannot pay that ETH fee.

faqs.question: What if I meant to send BNB, not the peg token?
faqs.answer: Then leave this page. BNB is the gas coin, marked with the native placeholder, and it has its own route to USDC. Approving 0x2170Ed0880ac9A755fd29B2688956BD959F933F8 will not spend BNB. Check the contract on BscScan before you sign. The Ethereum result would still be Circle USDC, not ETH.

faqs.question: Why does the USDC amount look smaller on Etherscan?
faqs.answer: Circle USDC uses 6 decimals. The peg you sent uses 18. The quote already converts those scales into whole tokens. Trust the minimum USDC, not the raw integers. This page does not promise a price. You still need ETH on Ethereum after Etherscan shows the token, or it cannot move.

description: Send Binance-Peg ETH from BNB Chain and receive Tether USDT on Ethereum. The peg is not the gas coin. Match both contracts on BscScan and Etherscan now.
intro:
Swap ETH from BNB Chain to USDT on Ethereum. You send Binance-Peg ETH on BNB Chain and you receive Tether USDT on Ethereum.

Approve 0x2170Ed0880ac9A755fd29B2688956BD959F933F8. BscScan shows that peg on chain id 56. BNB pays the gas, and blocks are about 3 seconds. The peg is not native ETH. Tether on Ethereum is 0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7, six decimals. Match it on Etherscan. Chain id 1. ETH gas has to be in the receiving wallet already, because USDT will not pay it.

sections.heading: Approve the peg, not the gas coin
sections.body: The wallet can show an ETH ticker and a BNB balance side by side. This route takes only 0x2170Ed0880ac9A755fd29B2688956BD959F933F8. BNB stays put unless you spend it on fees. Native ETH on Ethereum is not an input here. If the peg balance is zero, no approval amount will help. Keep some BNB or the approval never broadcasts.

sections.heading: Tether on Ethereum is six decimals
sections.body: 0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7 is the payout. It is Tether, not Circle and not Maker. Etherscan is where you confirm it. The jump from an 18-decimal peg to 6-decimal USDT is a display issue, not a hidden fee. Use the quote. USDT still cannot move until the same wallet holds ETH.

sections.heading: This does not deliver native ETH
sections.body: People open an ETH-labelled page and expect ether on Ethereum. This one pays Tether. If you wanted native ETH or WETH, switch pages. If you wanted to sell BNB, switch pages. If you only needed USDT on BNB Chain, do not bridge. [Ethereum](/chains/ethereum) is the network that will hold the Tether. The quote does not freeze the dollar amount.

sections.heading: BscScan for the send, Etherscan for the dollars
sections.body: Watch the peg leave on BscScan, chain id 56. Watch Tether arrive on Etherscan, chain id 1. Those screens are not interchangeable. A 3 second block is only the first chain. Ethereum blocks are about 12 seconds, and the bridge wait sits beyond both. Read the minimum USDT. If it is too low, do not sign.

faqs.question: Why did the wallet ask to approve ETH when gas is BNB?
faqs.answer: Because the ETH label on BNB Chain is the peg contract 0x2170Ed0880ac9A755fd29B2688956BD959F933F8, and pegs need an approval. BNB is what pays for that approval. BscScan will show both. The USDT you receive is 0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7 on Etherscan, and it is Tether, not ether.

faqs.question: Can I receive this USDT and spend it with no ETH?
faqs.answer: You can see it, and you cannot pay the fee to move it. Ethereum gas is ETH on chain id 1. Tether does not substitute. If the destination wallet is empty of ETH, add some before you need to transfer. The source gas, BNB, stays on BNB Chain and does not travel with the peg.

faqs.question: Is Binance-Peg ETH redeemable for native ETH on this page?
faqs.answer: No. This page sells the peg and buys Tether on Ethereum. It is not an unwrap and not a one-for-one release of native ETH. Native ETH would be a different route with the gas-coin marker as the payout. If that is what you wanted, do not sign this quote.

description: Send Binance-Peg ETH from BNB Chain and receive Maker DAI on Ethereum. The source is not BNB. Match the contracts on BscScan and Etherscan before you sign.
intro:
Swap ETH from BNB Chain to DAI on Ethereum. You send Binance-Peg ETH on BNB Chain and you receive Maker DAI on Ethereum.

The peg contract is 0x2170Ed0880ac9A755fd29B2688956BD959F933F8. Approve it on BNB Chain. BscScan is the explorer, chain id 56, gas in BNB, blocks about 3 seconds. Maker DAI is 0x6B175474E89094C44Da98b954EedeAC495271d0F, 18 decimals, on Etherscan. Chain id 1. DAI is not Circle and not Tether. It also will not pay Ethereum gas, so the receiving wallet needs ETH.

sections.heading: Pegged ether becomes Maker DAI
sections.body: You are not moving a gas coin. You approve 0x2170Ed0880ac9A755fd29B2688956BD959F933F8 and the route sells that token. BNB only covers the fee. The result is Maker's dollar token, which can drift from the peg you think of as one-for-one with cash. If you wanted Tether or Circle, this ending is the wrong tool.

sections.heading: DAI shares 18 decimals and still is not ETH
sections.body: Both the peg and DAI use 18 decimals, so the raw integers are less misleading than a 6-decimal hop. They are still different assets. Etherscan should show 0x6B175474E89094C44Da98b954EedeAC495271d0F and should not show a native ETH credit from this route. Hold ETH separately or the DAI cannot be transferred.

sections.heading: USDT or USDC means you opened the wrong page
sections.body: Those payouts exist from this same peg, on their own pages. Native ETH and WETH exist too. Sending BNB instead of the peg is another mistake this page will not quietly fix. [How bridges work](/learn/how-do-cross-chain-bridges-work) is the general wait, not a DAI price. If you did not need Ethereum, sell on BNB Chain.

sections.heading: You will want ETH waiting on chain id 1
sections.body: Plan the destination before you approve. ETH for gas, and a minimum DAI you would still accept. BNB Chain can confirm in about 3 seconds while the bridge is unfinished. Ethereum's own blocks are about 12 seconds and do not include that wait. Sign only on chain id 56, from the wallet that holds this peg.

faqs.question: Does the ETH label mean I will receive ETH and DAI?
faqs.answer: No. You send the peg at 0x2170Ed0880ac9A755fd29B2688956BD959F933F8 and you receive only Maker DAI at 0x6B175474E89094C44Da98b954EedeAC495271d0F. BscScan shows the send. Etherscan shows the DAI. Native ETH is something you must already have on Ethereum if you want to move that DAI. BNB paid the source fee.

faqs.question: Is Maker DAI the same as the USDT I use on BNB Chain?
faqs.answer: No. USDT on BNB Chain is a different peg and a different issuer. This payout is Maker, on Ethereum. If a desk asked for Tether, signing here is the wrong tool. Check 0x6B175474E89094C44Da98b954EedeAC495271d0F on Etherscan. Gas after arrival is ETH, not DAI and not BNB.

faqs.question: Will a fast BNB Chain confirmation lock the DAI amount?
faqs.answer: No. A block near 3 seconds only means the source chain moves quickly. The quote can still change before you sign, and this page does not promise a price or a finish time after you do. Read the minimum DAI. If the quote expired, request another rather than signing a stale screen.

description: Send Binance-Peg ETH from BNB Chain and receive WETH on Ethereum. These are different contracts. WETH cannot pay gas. Match both on BscScan and Etherscan.
intro:
Swap ETH from BNB Chain to WETH on Ethereum. You send Binance-Peg ETH on BNB Chain and you receive WETH on Ethereum.

The source contract is 0x2170Ed0880ac9A755fd29B2688956BD959F933F8. Approve it. BscScan shows it on chain id 56, where gas is BNB and blocks are about 3 seconds. The destination is 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2, canonical WETH. Match it on Etherscan. It is not the peg, and it is not native ETH. Chain id 1 charges gas in ETH. The WETH you receive cannot pay that gas.

sections.heading: Two tokens called ether, two contracts
sections.body: 0x2170Ed0880ac9A755fd29B2688956BD959F933F8 on BNB Chain and 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2 on Ethereum do not share a balance. Bridging is not a rename. You approve the peg, pay BNB, and hope to see WETH. If you hold only BNB, this page has nothing to sell. If you hold native ETH on Ethereum, this page does not wrap it.

sections.heading: Canonical WETH cannot pay gas
sections.body: After Etherscan shows the WETH, every move of it costs native ETH. A destination wallet with zero ETH is stuck, even though the ticker looks like the fee coin. Unwrapping WETH also costs ETH, and this route does not unwrap for you. Bring ETH before you need the wrapper to do anything.

sections.heading: Native ETH is a different landing
sections.body: If you wanted spendable ether, use the native ETH payout, where the marker means the gas coin. If you wanted USDC, USDT, or DAI, use those pages. If you wanted to sell BNB, you are on the wrong input. The [bridge guide](/learn/guides/how-to-bridge-assets-between-chains) walks the hop. It does not promise a WETH amount.

sections.heading: Do not send BNB to this approval
sections.body: The approval targets the peg contract only. BNB is reserved for the fee, and you should not drain it. Read the minimum WETH on the quote before you sign on chain id 56. BNB Chain's 3 second blocks and Ethereum's 12 second blocks are both shorter than a promise. If the floor is bad, stop.

faqs.question: If both tokens are ether, why are the addresses different?
faqs.answer: Because they are different tokens on different chains. The peg is 0x2170Ed0880ac9A755fd29B2688956BD959F933F8 on BscScan. WETH is 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2 on Etherscan. Native ETH, the gas coin, is a third thing and uses the 0xEeee marker. This page pays the WETH contract only. You need BNB to send and ETH to move the result.

faqs.question: Can I unwrap the arriving WETH without holding ETH?
faqs.answer: No. Unwrapping stays on Ethereum and the transaction fee is native ETH. This route does not include that unwrap. If your real goal was the gas coin, open the native ETH page before you sign. A wallet that receives only WETH cannot pay for its own unwrap.

faqs.question: Does approving the peg on BNB Chain wrap it into WETH there?
faqs.answer: No. The approval lets the route spend 0x2170Ed0880ac9A755fd29B2688956BD959F933F8. It does not wrap anything on BNB Chain, and it does not create WETH until the route completes on Ethereum. Check chain id 56 in the wallet. Gas for the approval is BNB. The quote can expire before the WETH exists.

description: Send native BNB from BNB Chain and receive Circle USDC on Ethereum. BNB is the gas coin, not the ETH peg. Match the USDC contract on Etherscan before you sign.
intro:
Swap BNB from BNB Chain to USDC on Ethereum. You send native BNB on BNB Chain and you receive Circle USDC on Ethereum.

The source marker 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE means the gas coin. On BNB Chain that coin is BNB, not the ETH peg. You do not approve an ERC-20 for it. BscScan shows a native send on chain id 56, and blocks are about 3 seconds. Leave extra BNB for the fee. Circle USDC is 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48 on Etherscan. Chain id 1. You will need ETH to move that USDC.

sections.heading: BNB leaves as the gas coin
sections.body: This page spends the native balance, the same BNB that pays fees. It does not spend Binance-Peg ETH at 0x2170Ed0880ac9A755fd29B2688956BD959F933F8, and it does not spend the USDT or USDC pegs. There is no token approval for the BNB itself. If you drain the wallet to the last BNB, the fee cannot be paid and the send stalls.

sections.heading: Circle dollars cannot pay Ethereum
sections.body: The contract you should see on Etherscan is 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48. It is Circle USDC, six decimals, not Tether and not DAI. USDC will not pay chain id 1 gas. ETH has to be in that wallet already, or the dollars sit still. BNB does not arrive alongside them.

sections.heading: The peg ETH token is not this input
sections.body: If the wallet's ETH ticker is the peg, this route will ignore it. Use the peg page. If you wanted native ETH or WETH on Ethereum, this USDC payout is the wrong tool. If you only needed USDC on BNB Chain, buy it there. [BNB Chain](/chains/bsc) is the network you are leaving. No Circle amount is promised.

sections.heading: Keep a remainder of BNB
sections.body: Split the balance in your head: BNB to sell, BNB to pay gas. The quote's minimum USDC is the floor for the part you sell. A 3 second block does not make the fee zero and does not finish the bridge. Ethereum blocks are about 12 seconds on their own. Sign on chain id 56. Do not use a destination someone sent you in chat.

faqs.question: Do I approve BNB before it can move to Ethereum USDC?
faqs.answer: No. Native BNB uses the marker 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE, which is not an ERC-20 approval. BscScan shows a native transfer on chain id 56. You only need extra BNB for the fee. The USDC you receive is 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48 on Etherscan, and that token cannot pay ETH gas.

faqs.question: I have ETH listed on BNB Chain. Will this page use it?
faqs.answer: No. That listing is the peg contract, not BNB. This route spends the gas coin only. If the peg is what you meant to sell, open the ETH-labelled page for USDC. Mixing them up sends the wrong asset. Check the native BNB balance before you sign.

faqs.question: The USDC arrived. Why can I not send it?
faqs.answer: The receiving wallet needs ETH. Circle USDC at 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48 does not pay fees on chain id 1. Etherscan can show the token while the wallet still fails a transfer. BNB you kept on BNB Chain does not help. Add ETH, then the USDC can move.

description: Send native BNB from BNB Chain and receive Tether USDT on Ethereum. No token approval on the BNB. Match the USDT contract on Etherscan and keep ETH for gas.
intro:
Swap BNB from BNB Chain to USDT on Ethereum. You send native BNB on BNB Chain and you receive Tether USDT on Ethereum.

0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE on the source means BNB, the gas coin on chain id 56. There is no ERC-20 approval. BscScan shows the native send. Blocks are about 3 seconds. Leave BNB for the fee. Tether on Ethereum is 0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7, six decimals, on Etherscan. Chain id 1. USDT cannot pay ETH gas, so the destination needs ETH already.

sections.heading: No approval on the BNB you send
sections.body: The gas-coin marker is not a contract you approve. This page will not pull Binance-Peg ETH, USDC, or USDT from BNB Chain. If those are the balances you meant, you are on the wrong route. Keep a BNB remainder for gas. Spending the entire native balance is how this send fails before it starts.

sections.heading: Tether arrives, ETH has to be there already
sections.body: Match 0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7 on Etherscan. It is Tether, not Circle and not DAI. Six decimals are normal for Ethereum USDT. The token does not include gas. A brand new Ethereum wallet will show USDT and still be unable to transfer it until you add ETH. BNB does not fill that gap.

sections.heading: Pegged ether is a different balance
sections.body: The ETH symbol on BNB Chain is 0x2170Ed0880ac9A755fd29B2688956BD959F933F8. This page ignores it. Native ETH and WETH as payouts are different pages too. If you wanted dollars without leaving BNB Chain, buy USDT there. [Ethereum](/chains/ethereum) is only the destination. The quote does not lock the Tether you will get.

sections.heading: A fast BNB Chain block is not the finish
sections.body: Chain id 56 can include your send in about 3 seconds. That is not a delivery clock for Etherscan, and it is not a locked price. Read the minimum USDT. Ethereum blocks are about 12 seconds once you are on that side, still separate from the bridge. Sign on BNB Chain only. Reject a destination address you did not generate.

faqs.question: Why is the source address the same string people use for ETH?
faqs.answer: Routers reuse 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE for whatever the gas coin is. On BNB Chain it is BNB. On Ethereum it would be ETH, but this page's payout is not that marker. The payout is Tether, 0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7, on Etherscan. BscScan shows the BNB leaving. There is no ERC-20 approval on the BNB.

faqs.question: Does Tether on Ethereum use the same decimals as USDT on BNB Chain?
faqs.answer: No. The USDT you receive uses 6 decimals. The USDT peg on BNB Chain uses 18, and this route is not even spending that peg. Read the quote in whole tokens. You still need ETH on chain id 1 to move the Tether after Etherscan shows it. BNB paid only the source fee.

faqs.question: What if I wanted USDC and the quote says USDT?
faqs.answer: Stop. This page pays Tether only. Circle USDC is a different contract and a different route from the same BNB balance. Signing because the dollar amount looks familiar is the wrong tool. Check 0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7 before you treat the wallet credit as the token a desk asked for.

description: Send native BNB from BNB Chain and receive Maker DAI on Ethereum. BNB is the gas coin. Match the DAI contract on Etherscan and keep ETH for later fees.
intro:
Swap BNB from BNB Chain to DAI on Ethereum. You send native BNB on BNB Chain and you receive Maker DAI on Ethereum.

The marker 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE means BNB on this source, the gas coin on chain id 56. No ERC-20 approval. BscScan records the native send. Blocks are about 3 seconds. Keep BNB for the fee. Maker DAI is 0x6B175474E89094C44Da98b954EedeAC495271d0F on Etherscan, 18 decimals. Chain id 1. DAI is not Tether and not Circle, and it will not pay ETH gas.

sections.heading: Native BNB for Maker's token
sections.body: You sell the gas coin and buy Maker DAI. The page will not sell the ETH peg and will not sell a stablecoin peg. If your BNB is only a thin remainder meant for fees, this route is the wrong tool, because the fee and the trade come from the same balance. Leave enough BNB that the transaction can still be mined.

sections.heading: DAI will not fuel chain id 1
sections.body: Etherscan should show 0x6B175474E89094C44Da98b954EedeAC495271d0F. That is the whole payout. It does not include native ETH. Without ETH, you cannot move the DAI, and you cannot wrap anything. BNB Chain gas and Ethereum gas are different coins on different explorers. Plan the ETH before you need the DAI to leave the wallet.

sections.heading: Dollar pages are not interchangeable
sections.body: USDC and USDT routes from BNB exist. So do routes that pay native ETH or WETH. This page is only Maker. A desk that named Tether will not accept this credit. If you did not need Ethereum, a BNB Chain swap is smaller. The [bridge guide](/learn/guides/how-to-bridge-assets-between-chains) covers the hop. It does not lock DAI.

sections.heading: The minimum is the only number to trust
sections.body: BNB can move while the route is open. The estimate is not the floor. The minimum DAI is the floor. A 3 second source block is a chain fact, not a completion time. Ethereum's 12 second blocks are another fact. Sign on chain id 56 from a wallet you control, and recheck the DAI contract if any character looks off.

faqs.question: Is the BNB I send the same as the ETH peg in my token list?
faqs.answer: No. BNB is the native gas coin, marker 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE, with no approval, visible as a native send on BscScan. The ETH peg is a separate contract you would have to approve. This page does not spend that peg. The DAI you receive is 0x6B175474E89094C44Da98b954EedeAC495271d0F on Etherscan.

faqs.question: Can Maker DAI pay the Ethereum transaction that moves it?
faqs.answer: No. Gas on chain id 1 is ETH. DAI is only the token this route delivers. If the wallet has DAI and no ETH, the transfer cannot be mined. BNB on BNB Chain cannot be attached to that Ethereum transaction. Add ETH first. This page does not send ETH alongside the DAI.

faqs.question: What if the quote expires while BNB Chain is still fast?
faqs.answer: Speed of the source block does not keep a quote alive. If it expires, request a new one and read the new minimum DAI. This page does not promise the old figure, and it does not promise a finish time. Gas for the send is still BNB. Do not sign a screen you did not refresh.

description: Send native BNB from BNB Chain and receive native ETH on Ethereum. The same marker means a different gas coin on each chain. Check BscScan and Etherscan.
intro:
Swap BNB from BNB Chain to ETH on Ethereum. You send native BNB on BNB Chain and you receive native ETH on Ethereum, the coin that pays gas there.

Both fields use 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE. On BNB Chain, chain id 56, that marker is BNB. On Ethereum, chain id 1, it is ETH. BscScan shows the BNB leaving. Etherscan shows the ETH arriving. There is no ERC-20 approval on either gas coin. Blocks on BNB Chain are about 3 seconds. Blocks on Ethereum are about 12 seconds. This is not WETH and not the Binance-Peg ETH token.

sections.heading: Same marker, BNB on one side and ETH on the other
sections.body: The placeholder is not one token that teleports. It means the gas coin of the chain you are looking at. Selling BNB and receiving ETH is a real trade between two volatile coins. The Binance-Peg ETH contract is not involved. If that peg is what you hold, this page will not take it. Keep some BNB, or the source fee cannot be paid.

sections.heading: The ether you receive can pay fees
sections.body: Because the payout is native ETH, it can pay later Ethereum fees once it is in the wallet. You do not need a prior ETH balance for that credit to be usable. That is different from receiving USDC, USDT, DAI, or WETH. Etherscan will not show an ERC-20 for this payout. Do not hunt for the marker as a token contract.

sections.heading: WETH and the peg token are easy to mix up
sections.body: WETH is a contract and a different page. The peg at 0x2170Ed0880ac9A755fd29B2688956BD959F933F8 is a different input. Dollar payouts are different pages too. If you only wanted to hold BNB, this route is the wrong tool. [How cross-chain bridges work](/learn/how-do-cross-chain-bridges-work) is the wait, not a rate. No ETH amount is locked.

sections.heading: Both coins move, so read the floor
sections.body: BNB and ETH can each move while the route is open. The minimum ETH is the number you are accepting, not the first estimate. A 3 second block on chain id 56 does not freeze that minimum. Sign the native send only from the BNB Chain wallet. If the floor is a smaller bag of ETH than you want, do not sign.

faqs.question: Why do both addresses look identical if the coins are different?
faqs.answer: The string 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE is a stand-in for the native gas coin, not a shared contract. BscScan's native asset is BNB on chain id 56. Etherscan's native asset is ETH on chain id 1. There is no ERC-20 approval on either side. The Binance-Peg ETH token is a third asset and is not this route.

faqs.question: Will I receive WETH that still needs unwrapping?
faqs.answer: No. This payout is native ETH, so it can pay gas on Ethereum after it arrives. WETH would be contract 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2 and would need ETH already in the wallet. If a pool requires that contract, you are on the wrong page. You still must leave BNB on the source for the send.

faqs.question: Can I reverse it if ETH drops after BscScan shows the send?
faqs.answer: No. A confirmed BNB send is not something this site can undo, and the price is not insured. Read the minimum ETH first. The 3 second block is only BNB Chain. It is not a promise about the ETH you will see on Etherscan, and it is not a promise about when that balance appears.

description: Send native BNB from BNB Chain and receive WETH on Ethereum. WETH is not the gas coin. Match the WETH contract on Etherscan and keep ETH for fees. Sign.
intro:
Swap BNB from BNB Chain to WETH on Ethereum. You send native BNB on BNB Chain and you receive WETH on Ethereum, not native ETH.

The BNB side is the marker 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE, the gas coin on chain id 56. No ERC-20 approval. BscScan shows the native send. Blocks are about 3 seconds. Leave BNB for the fee. WETH is 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2. Match it on Etherscan. Chain id 1. faqs.question: Is the WETH I receive able to pay Ethereum gas?
